blocks.text: A multi-building low-rise strata complex in phases. Building-directory data (BC Condos and Homes, secondary source) records the 4758 53 Street building as built in 1993 with 42 units, with bylaws noted as pets allowed with restrictions and rentals allowed with restrictions.

MLS data classifies homes here as Apartment/Condo, built 1996, in a townhouse-style ground-oriented form; a current listing describes a ground-floor 2-bed, 2-bath home and names the builder as Ledingham McAllister. It is condo product in MLS terms, but it does not live like an apartment building — no elevator block, no shared hallways.
Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: The working centre of Delta Manor is the grid around Delta Secondary School, 4615 51 Street, and Memorial Park, 5010 47 Avenue.
Ladner Village shops sit west of Chilukthan Slough, with commercial development on the east side of the slough, per the OCP's Ladner Village Core material.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: one tight pocket — the 53 Street / 54A Street blocks just east of the village core, where the Sunningdale buildings, Westham Lane, and the Adlington Court and Rosewood Court townhouse complexes all sit within a few blocks of each other. A second transit node matters for condo buyers: Ladner Exchange, beside Delta Hospital at 5800 Mountain View Blvd, where TransLink route 601 runs to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line).

Route 618 is the Ladner North loop from Ladner Exchange via Ladner Trunk Road, Central Avenue, Westminster Avenue and Crescent Drive; route 609 runs Ladner Exchange to South Delta Exchange via Arthur Drive and Ladner Trunk Road.
Ladner Leisure Centre, 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent, is the main Ladner recreation facility, and Ladner Pioneer Library is at 4683 51st Street.

The Highway 99 crossing is being rebuilt — on a new budget and timeline. On July 6, 2026, the Province announced an updated total budget of $8.5 billion for the Fraser River Tunnel Project, the eight-lane immersed-tube tunnel replacing the George Massey Tunnel, with the federal government contributing up to $3 billion, major construction expected to begin in 2027, and early construction work already continuing. That crossing is the commute every Delta Manor condo buyer is pricing.
The City's Ladner Village Revitalization Action Plan, including the Chisholm Street Wharf project, is the named project set for the village core a short walk west of the 53 Street condo pocket.

The 2024 OCP replaced the old area-plan structure. Buyers reading older City documents will see references to a Ladner Area Plan; the consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), folded it into a single Land Use Plan, which now governs future change in central Ladner.

SSMUH changed the streets around the condos in 2024. Delta's June 24, 2024 SSMUH adoption (Bylaws 8394 and 8395) lets many detached lots around Delta Manor add suites, duplex units, coach houses and garden suites without a rezoning — which is why infill keeps appearing on the blocks between the condo pocket and the village.

Delta's 2026 tax calendar penalizes late payment twice. The City's 2026 property tax due date was July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on outstanding balances after that date and a further 5% after September 2, 2026 — relevant to completion-date adjustments on any condo closing that straddles those dates.

blocks.text: A townhouse complex: MLS data records 63 units in the development, strata plan LMS2857, wood frame, freehold strata, managed by Wynford, built 1997–1998 (sources differ by a year).

A townhouse complex across the street: listing data classifies homes here as Townhouse, 2 storeys, wood frame with vinyl siding, built 1996, with strata-type services recorded (maintenance grounds, management, snow removal) and carport/open parking.
Where the townhomes are and what to know

items.t: Where the townhouse stock actually concentrates: one tight pocket — the 53 Street / 54A Street blocks just east of the village core, where Adlington Court and Rosewood Court sit within a few blocks of each other and of the Sunningdale apartment buildings. A second pocket is the 52A Street area, where the Laburnum Park Place bare-land strata sits.

Transit: Ladner Exchange, beside Delta Hospital at 5800 Mountain View Blvd, is the hub; TransLink route 601 runs to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), route 618 is the Ladner North loop, and route 609 runs Ladner Exchange to South Delta Exchange via Arthur Drive.

Depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle: Since July 1, 2024, strata corporations with five or more strata lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years and can no longer defer it by a vote; reports carry a 30-year projection of repair and replacement costs and three CRF cash-flow models. Adlington Court (63 lots) is squarely inside this rule.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Delta Manor

items.t: The sub-area's stock is single detached houses on fee-simple lots under the urban Ladner zones, with secondary suites as an accessory use in RS1 and SSMUH options (duplexes, coach houses, garden suites) under the City's amendments. Fee-simple plainly: no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees.

Lot character: the zoning minimums frame the lot pattern — RS5 550 m² (or 460 m² outside the SFR designation), RS6 390 m², RS7 335 m², duplex zones RD1 836 m² and RD4 504 m², with RS1 at 4,000 m² in lower-density pockets; the zone on any given parcel is read off the City zoning maps, parcel by parcel.

Laburnum Park Place — Laburnum Park Place, off the 52A Street area, Ladner (MLS sub-area: Delta Manor). Bare-land strata: Detached ranchers on bare land strata lots, with MLS data recording "Bylaws Restriction: Age Restrictions, Age Restricted 55+". Plainly: a bare-land strata lot is strata tenure — the buyer owns the strata lot (essentially the building lot itself) and the rancher on it, and Form B, strata fees for common property, and registered bylaws apply to the lot. It is not a fee-simple lot.
The conflict, both bases stated
Any individual parcel's ALR status is checked on the ALC maps by PID or civic address.
Serviced vs unserviced: this is a serviced urban grid's framing. For any unserviced parcel: GWELLS, plus Fraser Health's onsite-sewerage position.

Assemblies / development sites / rezoning proposals: The City's Ladner Village Revitalization Action Plan (including the Chisholm Street Wharf project) is a Ladner-area civic project set named by the City — it is west of this sub-area's core and is not lot inventory.

blocks.text: Where lots come up and what to know

items.t: Municipality and plan: Ladner, one of the City of Delta's three communities (Ladner, Tsawwassen, North Delta — Ladner and Tsawwassen together are South Delta), under the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future", Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan. Farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)" (s. 1.5.1).

Anchors: Delta Secondary, 4615 51 St, is in this sub-area; Memorial Park is at 5010 47 Avenue; Ladner Leisure Centre at 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent; Ladner Pioneer Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library) at 4683 51st Street; Delta Hospital at 5800 Mountain View Blvd, beside the Ladner Exchange bus loop.
Schools (SD37; Ministry-listed names only): catchments are address-based. SD37 also publishes Ladner Area catchment boundary maps (updated October 2017).

Transit: route 601 runs South Delta to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line) via Ladner Exchange; route 618 is the Ladner North loop via Ladner Trunk Road, Central Avenue, Westminster Avenue and Crescent Drive; route 609 runs Ladner Exchange to South Delta Exchange via Arthur Drive.

Bare-land strata block (applies to Laburnum Park Place lots): Form B (SPA s. 59) discloses monthly fees, amounts owed, approved levies still payable, CRF balance and insurance summary, with rules, budget and most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page. Depreciation reports every 5 years for strata corporations with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024, non-deferrable. CRF minimum contribution 10% since November 1, 2023. Rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022 (long-term; short-term may still be restricted). Only 55+ age bylaws are valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Regulation 7.01, incl. May 1, 2023 exemptions) — Laburnum's MLS-recorded "Age Restricted 55+" is the only lawful form; a "45+" listing line is not a valid BC age bylaw. Fee-simple contrast: the grid's fee-simple lots carry none of this.

Two Ladner bare-land stratas get confused constantly — they are different complexes in different sub-areas. Laburnum Park Place is here (Delta Manor, off 52A Street); South Pointe is in Neilsen Grove and is the one with strata plan NWS2528. A search, alert or offer built on the wrong plan number is built on the wrong complex.

The sub-area's seniors infrastructure is civic, not strata. McKee Seniors Recreation Centre (5155 47 Avenue, at Memorial Park, opened 2005) and the City's free Seniors Bus (home-based at McKee) sit in this grid — services a Laburnum buyer gets from the city, not the strata.

The Evergreen Lane names are a trap of a different kind. Evergreen Court (4625) and Evergreen Plaza (4603) are 55+ non-market rentals; Evergreen Downs (4600), same lane, is family housing with no age requirement in the City guide — rentals, nothing to buy, but routinely confused with ownership stock.

Ladner's Landing is the historic root of this grid. The Canadian Register of Historic Places entry (sourced to the Corporation of Delta Planning Department) records Ladner's Landing on the south shore of the Fraser River, where the Government Wharf was built and William H. Ladner pre-empted land that is now the Village of Ladner.

blocks.text: Delta Manor: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) is the main rule change here: Delta adopted zoning on June 24, 2024 permitting suites, coach houses and garden suites on single-detached and duplex lots without rezoning.
Older Delta Manor lots can carry restrictive covenants that prohibit secondary suites; Delta's 2020 amendment process dealt with discharging those covenants where no variance is needed.

blocks.text: Delta Manor: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Delta Secondary has stood on its 51 Street site in some form since the Ladner school centre opened there, making the school, not a shopping street, the area's landmark.
Ladner Leisure Centre at 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent and the Ladner Pioneer Library at 4683 51 Street are the daily-life anchors just west of the grid.
Route 618 is the Ladner North loop from Ladner Exchange via Ladner Trunk Road, Central Avenue, Westminster Avenue and Crescent Drive — the local circulator for the streets north of the village.

blocks.text: Delta Manor: development and new projects

items.t: Area-plan items for this guide's own area come first: the Ladner Village (LV1) Development Permit Area governs form and character for new multi-unit buildings at the village edge of Delta Manor.
Route 601 is the spine: it runs from South Delta to Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line, stopping at Ladner Exchange beside Delta Hospital.
Route 609 links Ladner Exchange to South Delta Exchange via Arthur Drive and Ladner Trunk Road, which is the direct Ladner-to-Tsawwassen bus from this area.

blocks.text: Delta Manor: risks and due diligence

items.t: Flood is the first check in low-lying Ladner: Delta sits between the Fraser River, Boundary Bay and the Strait of Georgia and maintains over 63 kilometres of dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection; ask which side of the dike a lot sits on.
Check the title for suite-prohibiting covenants and any flood covenant before removing subjects; the City page on suite amendments explains why those covenants exist on older lots.

faq.a: It is set building by building in the strata budget attached to the Form B.
faq.q: What do strata fees cover in the Sunningdale buildings?

faq.a: For long-term rentals, yes in law: every BC strata rental-restriction bylaw has been invalid since Nov 24, 2022, whatever an older directory entry says. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw, so read the registered bylaws before counting on nightly-rental income.
faq.q: Can I rent out my condo here?

faq.a: Listings at Sunningdale record garage parking under the building plus guest parking, and a storage locker with the 4728 unit described. Parking and storage can be assigned, rented, or part of the strata lot — the Form B states the specific unit's allocation, which is what to rely on.
faq.q: Is parking underground, and is storage included?

faq.a: Read the CRF balance and the depreciation report attached to the Form B. Stratas with five or more lots must now refresh that report every five years, and its three CRF funding models show whether fees are keeping up with the 30-year repair list or whether owners face catch-up levies.
faq.q: How healthy is the building financially — and could a big levy be coming?

faq.a: Since 2023 the Form B must include a summary of the strata corporation's insurance coverage. The water-damage deductible in that summary is the number that matters most for a wood-frame low-rise: owners are routinely responsible for deductibles charged back after a leak from their unit.
faq.q: What does the strata's insurance cover, and what is the deductible?

faq.a: Two known, both strata townhouses on 54A Street: Adlington Court (63 units, LMS2857) and Rosewood Court (built 1996). Westham Lane on 52A Street is an apartment building (LMS2591, 58 units), and Laburnum Park Place is a bare-land strata of detached ranchers — neither is a townhouse complex.
faq.q: How many townhouse complexes are there in Delta Manor, really?

faq.a: It is set complex by complex in the budget attached to the Form B. Rosewood Court's listing data records maintenance grounds, management and snow removal; a townhouse owner typically carries more of the home's own exterior and insurance than an apartment owner does, and the Form B and bylaws state the exact split for the specific complex.
faq.q: What do strata fees cover in a townhouse strata here, versus the Sunningdale apartments?

faq.a: For long-term rentals, yes in law: every BC strata rental-restriction bylaw has been invalid since Nov 24, 2022, whatever an older directory entry says. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw, so read the registered bylaws before counting on nightly-rental income.
faq.q: Can I rent out my townhouse?

faq.a: Only if that half is legally separate — a strata lot in a 2-lot strata plan, or its own fee-simple lot after an approved subdivision.
faq.q: A listing here says "duplex" — can I buy half of it?

faq.a: Catchment is address-based, so check the exact address before you buy. The district says families verify their catchment school through its School Locator or the board office, and Delta runs elementary schools from kindergarten to grade 7 and secondary schools from grade 8 to grade 12, with no middle-school tier. Delta Secondary itself stands inside this area at 4615 51 Street.
faq.q: Which schools serve a Delta Manor address?

faq.a: No official City boundary was confirmed for the name. It is a board sub-area name for central Ladner, anchored by Delta Secondary and Memorial Park at 5010 47 Avenue, so two listings both labelled Delta Manor can sit on quite different streets. Ask which street, not just which sub-area name.
faq.q: Is Delta Manor an official neighbourhood?

faq.a: Possibly, without a rezoning. Delta's Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) rules, adopted June 24, 2024, let owners apply at building-permit stage for secondary suites, garden suites and coach houses on single-detached and duplex lots. A title covenant can still block a suite, so read the title before counting on rental income.
faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house?

faq.a: The Delta Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future", Bylaw No. 8400, is the City's adopted OCP, and the Ladner Village Revitalization Action Plan covers Village projects including the Chisholm Street Wharf.
faq.q: What plan covers future change in this part of Ladner?
